title: Air Force documents on Hans Kohler's capture by the Americans
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Air Force documents on Hans Kohler's capture by the Americans, about 1940s at Germany, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we now even have air force documents knowing that we Hans Conler was apprehended by the Americans.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that US Air Force documents now show that a man named Hans Kohler was caught by the Americans in Germany in the 1940s. He brings it up as written proof of a story that had circulated about this man, which would tie him to what the Americans took from Germany after the war.
